verdict.rationale: The skill ships in the open Agent Skills format, a folder with a SKILL.md. It is installed by copying the folder into a skills directory and works in any agent that supports skills, so it is plain readable files that carry across harnesses. The zip and plugin routes are just packaging of the same folder. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the skill running in a non-Claude harness.

support.subject: As a developer, skills are plain markdown files and folders I can read, copy, and carry to another harness — not a proprietary binary format
